responding_to.type: bus passengers trapped by rising water

output.english: This is a practice flood alert for Richmond, VA. There is flooding and danger near Dock St, Lee Bridge, Broad & 3rd, Shockoe Bottom, Riverside Apartments, Downtown Junction and East Junction. Stay away from those areas and do not walk or drive through flood water.
output.spanish: Este es un alerta de inundación de práctica para Richmond, VA. Hay inundación y peligro cerca de Dock St, Lee Bridge, Broad & 3rd, Shockoe Bottom, Riverside Apartments, Downtown Junction y East Junction. Manténgase lejos de esas áreas y no camine ni maneje en el agua.
